# Generated Files Reference

## Core Rule

Generated files usually say how they were produced. Confirm by searching the target and `regen/`, `Porting/`, `Makefile.SH`, and nearby tests before editing.

```sh
rg -n "DO NOT EDIT|This file is built|Generated from|autogenerated|regen" FILE
rg -n "FILE|basename_without_suffix" regen Porting Makefile.SH pod
```

## Common Maps

- `proto.h`, `embed.h`, `embedvar.h`, `long_names.c`: `embed.fnc`, `intrpvar.h`, `perlvars.h`, `regen/opcodes`, `regen/embed.pl`, `regen/embed_lib.pl`, `regen/HeaderParser.pm`; use `perl-embed-fnc`.
- `pod/perlapi.pod`, `pod/perlintern.pod`: `autodoc.pl` plus `=for apidoc` entries and `embed.fnc`; use `perl-embed-fnc` for API docs.
- `opnames.h`, `opcode.h`, op metadata: `regen/opcodes`, `regen/op_private`, `regen/opcode.pl`; use `perl-parser-optree-ops`.
- `perly.act`, `perly.h`, `perly.tab`: `perly.y` via `regen_perly.pl`; use `perl-parser-optree-ops`.
- `regnodes.h`, regex node table in `pod/perldebguts.pod`: `regcomp.sym`, `op_reg_common.h`, `regexp.h`, `regen/regcomp.pl`; use `perl-regex-engine`.
- `mg_vtable.h`: `regen/mg_vtable.pl`; use `perl-sv-magic-memory`.
- `warnings.h`: `regen/warnings.pl` and warning category data.
- `feature.h`: `regen/feature.pl`.
- `keywords.c`, `keywords.h`: `regen/keywords.pl`.
- `reentr.c`, `reentr.h`: `regen/reentr.pl`.
- `regcharclass.h`, `regexp_constants.h`, `charclass_invlists.inc`, `uni_keywords.h`, `unicode_constants.h`: Unicode and charset generators under `regen/`.
- `pod/perltoc.pod`: `pod/buildtoc`; POD lists also involve `Porting/pod_rules.pl`.
- `META.yml`, `META.json`, maintainer metadata, MANIFEST ordering: `Porting/` tools and make targets.

## Commands

```sh
make regen
make regen_headers
make regen-headers
make regen_perly
make regen-perly
make regen_meta
make manisort
./perl -Ilib t/porting/regen.t
./perl -Ilib t/porting/manifest.t
```

`make regen` runs `regen.pl` and many, but not all, generators. Header-focused work often uses `make regen_headers` or `make regen-headers`. Parser artifacts use `make regen_perly` or `make regen-perly`.

## Validation Tests

```sh
./perl -Ilib t/porting/regen.t
./perl -Ilib t/porting/header_parser.t
./perl -Ilib t/porting/args_assert.t
./perl -Ilib t/porting/podcheck.t
./perl -Ilib t/porting/pod_rules.t
./perl -Ilib t/porting/perlfunc.t
./perl -Ilib t/porting/manifest.t
```

## Useful Searches

```sh
rg -n "open_new|read_only_bottom_close_and_rename|regen_lib|Generated from|DO NOT EDIT" regen Porting pod *.c *.h
rg -n "regen_headers|regen-headers|regen_perly|regen-perly|regen_meta|manisort" Makefile.SH Cross win32
rg -n "regen\\.t|header_parser|pod_rules|manifest|args_assert|autodoc|makedef" t/porting regen Porting
```
